summary: Full backend + frontend E2E regression for iteration 3 (Language / Tags / Notes / PATCH / Retry). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases in test_language_tags_notes.py PASS (15.6s) — Spanish transcript correctly detects language='Spanish' with summary+commitments written in Spanish (accented chars, 'cancelación', 'reembolso'), transcript_sha256+verify still match; tag dedupe on POST /records is case-insensitive with first-seen casing preserved ('TEST_billing','TEST_Billing','TEST_refund','TEST_es' -> ['TEST_billing','TEST_refund','TEST_es']); notes are stored & returned; PATCH /api/records/{id} updates tags+notes, preserves transcript_sha256 and verification_status, and returns updated doc; PATCH unknown id -> 404; GET /api/tags returns sorted distinct tags; ?tag= filter returns only records containing that tag; ?q= matches on tags AND notes; DELETE still soft-deletes and returns 404 on repeat; auth still required on /records, /tags, /trial, POST /records. Frontend: Home -> Create -> Paste Transcript -> Continue -> Review & Process (agent name, Support type, tags via input+add, notes, consent) -> Process -> Conversation Receipt renders 'Language: English' row, 'Tags & Notes' card with chips (receipt-tag-*) + notes text (receipt-notes), SHA-256 block. Verify Integrity banner turns green with 'Record integrity verified'. Edit modal opens, adding tag + updating notes -> Save -> receipt reflects both (chips and notes updated live). Records tab renders a horizontal tag filter row (tag-chip-all + tag-chip-<t>); tapping a tag chip filters, All clears; records-search matches tag substrings. Record card shows chips. Record Conversation screen loads without crash (record-start visible); retry testIDs (record-transcribe-error, record-use) are present in source and rendered on the error path only (not on entry, as expected). Cleanup: RCP-2026-000007 (created during UI E2E) hard-cleaned via DELETE; only seeded RCP-2026-000001 remains. No React Native / Expo deprecation issues detected in touched files.

ui_bugs.issue: Frontend addTag has case-insensitive dedupe (line 39: tags.some(x => x.toLowerCase() === t.toLowerCase())) but rapid successive taps (300ms apart) allowed 'TEST_uiTag' and 'TEST_uitag' to both appear as chips (3 chips instead of 2). Backend correctly re-dedupes on POST, so the receipt shows the right final set — user impact is only a brief mismatch in the chip preview. Likely a stale-closure race in the Pressable onPress; consider using a functional setTags(prev => ...) to guarantee dedupe.

action_items: OPTIONAL / LOW: harden create/finalize.tsx addTag to use functional setState (setTags(prev => prev.some(x=>x.toLowerCase()===t.toLowerCase()) ? prev : [...prev, t])) to eliminate the stale-closure race that allowed case-only-different duplicates to appear briefly in the chip preview. Backend already dedupes correctly, so this is UX polish only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /records tag normalization (L320-326) and PATCH /records/{id} (L410-416) share the same dedupe pattern — consider extracting into a helper _clean_tags(list[str]) to DRY.

server.py PATCH /records/{id} correctly returns the updated doc via a second find_one after update_one, and correctly excludes _id in the projection. It also does NOT touch transcript, transcript_sha256, or verification_status — verified via test.
server.py list_records $or search regex includes {tags: rx} which works because Mongo applies the regex element-wise on array fields — confirmed by test_records_q_matches_tags.
receipt/[id].tsx correctly renders 'Language' MetaRow only when record.language is truthy (L206), and the Tags & Notes card is present with editable modal — good separation.
records.tsx tag-chip filter row + records-search both wired through the same q/tag query params — no duplication of filtering logic on the client, single source of truth is the backend query.
